playstyle: Four orruk brawlers with modest durability: 4 Health each, mostly 1-dodge saves and an average 3 Move rising to 4 when Inspired. With no warscroll of its own, the mob relies on a generic Destruction warscroll, so its strength lies in solid 2-damage melee and range-3 shooting from Hedkrakka and Dakko. Inspired weapons gain extra dice and Grievous, Cleave or Brutal. The warband wins by ganging up on lone enemies, Flanking and Surrounding targets to Inspire and focus down foes in close-range brawls.
